Q6111.reason: The ordinance is content-neutral and serves an important interest, so under O'Brien it can apply to expressive littering, even though dumping trash is expressive conduct.

Q5735.reason: Only defendants may remove under 28 U.S.C. § 1441, so the plaintiff's removal was improper and the federal court must remand the entire case.

Q5651.reason: The 1964 model description in the ad is an express warranty that an 'as is' clause cannot negate, and the car delivered was a different model.
